items.name: Memebook
items.tagline: The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK ut

steps.title: Fund a Solana Wallet
steps.body: Install Phantom or Solflare and keep a small amount of SOL in it for network fees, tips, and any paid Pass tier. You can buy SOL on Bybit and withdraw straight to your Solana address.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Mint Page
steps.body: Open the Memebook mint page , connect the wallet you just funded, and sign the verification message. Use this same wallet throughout, since XP is tied to the address rather than a username.

steps.title: Verify Your X and Telegram Accounts
steps.body: Link both accounts on the mint page. Verification is required before minting and includes following the Memebook X account and joining the Telegram channel.

steps.title: Mint Your Memebook Pass
steps.body: Bronze is free and gets you into the app. Paid tiers raise your XP multiplier and daily limits, which compounds across every post. The Pass is soulbound, so it stays attached to the minting wallet and cannot be resold.

steps.title: Install the Android App
steps.body: Download Memebook from Google Play and sign in with the wallet holding your Pass. There is no iOS build, so an Android device is required for the in-app half of the campaign.

steps.title: Post and Engage Daily
steps.body: Publish photos or reels, like and comment on other creators, and complete the daily check-in. Spreading activity across days earns more than dumping the same volume into one session.

steps.title: Tip Creators and Share Your Invite Code
steps.body: Send SOL tips to posts you like, which is an on-chain action and counts toward your activity. Then share your invite link from the app to earn XP when someone you referred mints a Pass.

items.description: The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK utility at TGE. The allocation size and the XP-to-token rate have not been announced, so the sensible goal right now is banking XP rather than modelling a payout.

steps.title: Visit the DeepBook Waitlist
steps.body: Go to the DeepBook waitlist page and enter your email address to request early access to the new trading app.

steps.title: Verify Your Email
steps.body: Open the confirmation email DeepBook sends and click the verification link to lock in your spot on the list.

steps.title: Refer Traders to Move Up the Queue
steps.body: Share your referral link with other traders. Each signup through your link moves you higher in the queue, since access opens in waves rather than all at once.

steps.title: Visit the DeepBook Claims Portal
steps.body: Go to the DeepBook claims portal . Read and accept the terms of use and privacy policy before moving on.

steps.title: Confirm You Have SUI for Gas
steps.body: Claiming is an on-chain transaction, so your wallet needs a small amount of SUI to cover the network fee. If you need some, you can buy SUI from Binance , or swap and bridge funds using the widget below.

steps.title: Connect Your Season 1 Wallet
steps.body: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Click “Connect Wallet” and link the same wallet you used to earn points during Season 1. Approve the connection request in your wallet. If you traded from more than one address, connect each separately to check for allocations.

steps.title: Review and Submit Your Claim
steps.body: Check the DEEP allocation shown, then submit the claim transaction and approve it in your wallet. Once it confirms, your DEEP appears in the connected wallet.

items.description: DeepBook’s main live campaign is the waitlist for its new trading app. Access opens in waves, and referring other traders moves you up the queue for earlier entry. Joining early and building referrals may position you for future rewards, though DeepBook has not confirmed a waitlist allocation.

steps.body: Visit the submission portal and sign in with the EVM wallet you registered Create or select a Canopy wallet to receive tokens The locked portion is already credited to your wallet and releases on its own schedule, so there is nothing further to claim, sign, or pay gas for.

items.name: Flop Labs
items.tagline: The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block

steps.title: Follow Flop Labs on X
steps.body: Follow the official Flop Labs X account and turn on notifications. This is the only requirement the project has published for eligibility, and it is where testnet dates will land first.

steps.title: Follow Arthur Hayes for early terms
steps.body: Follow CryptoHayes and subscribe to his Substack. His essays have carried more detail than the project account, including the 20% testnet figure, and more are coming. Terms tend to surface there first.

steps.title: Apply for a network role
steps.body: Open the Flop website and submit the form matching what you can deliver. Three of the four roles are open: GPU provider or miner: for anyone with hardware that can run inference. Miners earn block rewards plus payment per job. No minimum specifications have been published, so treat any circulating hardware requirement as unverified. Validator: confirms miners completed their assigned work and stores agent memory. Suited to people comfortable running nodes. KOL or creator: the lowest barrier of the three. A few solid posts plus the form is the entry price, and Substack counts, which helps if your X account is weak. The fourth role, Agents, is the demand side: they spend $FLOP rather than earn it, so there is nothing to apply for.

steps.title: Start publishing $FLOP content now
steps.body: If you took the creator route, post before the program formally opens. There is no leaderboard yet, and if scoring ends up mindshare-based it will likely be applied retroactively. Stay on theme: decentralized inference, GPU economics, Hayes’ argument that the AI buildout is a debt problem rather than a technology one.

steps.title: Get ready for the Q4 testnet
steps.body: The 20% allocation is earned on the testnet, which has not opened. Hold off on configuring a wallet for a specific network, because Flop Labs has not named the chain. Watch the official account and be ready to onboard when it goes live.

items.description: The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block in Q1 2027, though eligibility rules and snapshot dates are unpublished. His 19 August essay put roughly 20% of supply with testnet participants, released across ten years.

items.name: Blackboard
items.tagline: Blackboard has not confirmed a token or an airdrop. What exists is Board Point, a rewards balance tied to trading activi

steps.title: Join the Blackboard Waitlist
steps.body: Go to the Blackboard waitlist page and sign up with a Google or X account. Your rank updates live, and higher ranked users reach Alpha sooner.

steps.title: Follow Blackboard and Post the Referral Tweet
steps.body: Link your X account in the waitlist task list, follow Blackboard , and then post the referral tweet the page generates. Blackboard verifies both before crediting the task, which is worth 60 points.

steps.title: Share Your Invite Link
steps.body: Copy the invite link from your waitlist dashboard. Every friend who joins through it adds 30 points to your score. Invite codes also circulate through partners and selected communities.

steps.title: Create Your Blackboard Account
steps.body: When access opens, sign in at the Blackboard terminal with Google, Apple or email, or connect a wallet you already use. Social login creates an embedded self-custodial wallet, so you hold the keys either way.

steps.title: Deposit USDC to Your Blackboard Wallet
steps.body: Open Deposit from the Portfolio screen, choose the asset and network, then send funds to the address shown. Picking the wrong network can lose the deposit permanently. Instant and free: USDC on Arbitrum, Polygon, HyperEVM or Solana Routed for a fee shown before you confirm: USDC on Ethereum, Base or BNB Chain Also accepted: USDT credited as USDC, $10 minimum You can buy USDC on Bybit and withdraw straight to Arbitrum , or shift what you already hold onto a supported network with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Trade Perpetual Futures
steps.body: Open the Trade tab and pick a market. Volume lands on two protocols that each run their own reward programs, so one position builds history in more than one place.

steps.title: Invite Traders From Inside the Terminal
steps.body: Grab your referral code from My Page once you are trading. You earn 10% of the Blackboard fee on every trade your invitees make. Self-referral is banned and rebates can be clawed back.

items.description: Blackboard has not confirmed a token or an airdrop. What exists is Board Point, a rewards balance tied to trading activity, plus a live leaderboard and a referral program paying 10% of the Blackboard fee on invited users’ trades. Earning rates are still being finalized.

items.tagline: No Acepyr airdrop has been announced. The company’s terms are blunt: testnet $ACEPYR is a symbolic point system with no

steps.title: Create Your Acepyr Account
steps.body: Sign up at Acepyr with an email and password, entering referral code PW34SD3C2J during registration. Codes only count when applied at signup. Verify your email to activate the account.

steps.title: Accept the Legal Documents and Complete Onboarding
steps.body: First login walks you through the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Testnet Points Notice, then the onboarding survey. Those steps plus your first sign-in pay 300 testnet $ACEPYR.

steps.title: Link a Wallet You Control
steps.body: In Settings, link a wallet by signing a message; a pasted address does not qualify. One address links to one account permanently, and linking pays 500 testnet $ACEPYR.

steps.title: Join the Mainnet Waitlist
steps.body: The most productive click on the platform. Joining needs a proven wallet holding at least the current minimum, now $10, read live across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BSC. Native coins and major stablecoins count, and nothing is sent to Acepyr, so balances you already hold for Base , Arbitrum or Optimism farming clear the check. Joining pays 1,000 testnet $ACEPYR, puts the first 10,000 qualifying accounts in line for $5 at launch, and activates whoever referred you. Short of the minimum? Pick up ETH or USDC on Bybit , then use the widget below to move it onto Base or another supported chain. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Trade the Live Up or Down Markets
steps.body: Take Up or Down on a five-minute window and let the price feed settle it. Three first-time achievements sit here: Open your first position: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Place your first limit order: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Close your first profitable position: 300 testnet $ACEPYR

steps.title: Enter the Weekly Tournament
steps.body: Entry is free and individual, with no ticket and no minimum balance. One settled trade that week makes you valid and earns a share of the 10,000 testnet $ACEPYR pool.

steps.title: Build a Sign-In Streak
steps.body: The streak pays at five rungs: 50 at two days, 100 at three, 300 at seven, 500 at fourteen and 1,000 at thirty. Each rung banks permanently.

steps.title: Generate Your Referral Code
steps.body: Open Profile, then Referrals. Codes reset every month and points do not carry over.

items.description: No Acepyr airdrop has been announced. The company’s terms are blunt: testnet $ACEPYR is a symbolic point system with no economic value, it cannot be bought, and it may never be worth anything.

items.name: Beldex
items.tagline: Beldex runs a Loyalty Program that awards Beldex Points for social and community tasks and ranks participants on a publi

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Loyalty Dashboard
steps.body: Open the Beldex Loyalty Program and connect an EVM wallet. Your points and rank attach to that address, so use a wallet you intend to keep.

steps.title: Link Your X Account
steps.body: Connect X from the dashboard before starting tasks. Rewards do not pay out without an X connection, and the same applies to anyone you refer.

steps.title: Clear the Community Tasks
steps.body: One-time actions that you need to complete from the airdrop page that cover most of your opening balance: Follow Beldex on X (100 points) Follow Beldex on LinkedIn (100 points) Join the Discord server (100 points) Subscribe to the YouTube channel (100 points) Join the Telegram community group (50 points) Join the Telegram announcement channel (50 points) Join the X Community (50 points)

steps.title: Complete the Limited-Time and Collab Tasks
steps.body: The dashboard rotates timed partner tasks, usually a follow or a like. Some run for days, others expire in under eight hours, so clear them on sight.

steps.title: Post About Beldex on X Daily
steps.body: Write a post about Beldex, tag @BeldexCoin, then paste the link into the Submit Post field. This pays 20 points and resets every 24 hours. Spam risks rejection, so write about a product or update you have used.

steps.title: Check In Once Per Week
steps.body: The weekly check-in pays 20 points and resets every seven days. One click, and skipping it is the easiest way to leak points over a long campaign.

steps.title: Generate Your Referral Link and Invite Friends
steps.body: Use the Get My Referral Link button. You earn 20% of your direct referrals’ earnings plus 5% from anyone they refer, and each friend gets 100 XP for signing up through you. Credit takes 24 to 48 hours, and referred accounts must connect X first.

items.description: Beldex runs a Loyalty Program that awards Beldex Points for social and community tasks and ranks participants on a public leaderboard. The program page states that point holders become eligible for an airdrop and other incentives, but the points-to-BDX conversion rate, the reward pool size, and the snapshot date have not been announced.

steps.title: Open the DropWave Reservation Portal
steps.body: Go to the Gyndore reservation portal . The old DropWave campaign page now redirects here, so any saved bookmark should land in the same place.

steps.title: Connect the Wallet You Used in Season One
steps.body: Reservations attach to existing Season One profiles. Connect the same wallet that collected Chips during the campaign, since a fresh wallet has no allocation tied to it.

steps.title: Authenticate Your DropWave Profile
steps.body: The portal verifies the X account you linked during the campaign before it shows a balance. Approve the sign-in request so your GynPoints can be matched to the connected wallet.

steps.title: Confirm Your Base Receiving Address
steps.body: Set the Base address that should receive bGYND. Use an address you hold the keys to, because exchange deposit addresses often reject tokens they have not listed.

steps.title: Submit Before September 9
steps.body: Confirm the reservation and check that the portal shows it as reserved. Gyndore has not announced a fallback for allocations left unreserved after 09.09.26, so treat the date as final.

items.description: DropWave Season One has closed. The campaign paid out Chips for wallet and social activity, those Chips converted into GynPoints, and GynPoints set leaderboard position for the $GYND distribution. Season One participants now have a short window to lock in what they earned: the reservation portal is live, and allocations must be reserved by September 9, 2026.

steps.title: Acquire JUP to Stake
steps.body: ASR pays stakers, so you need JUP in a Solana wallet such as Phantom or Solflare. Buy it on Binance and withdraw to your Solana address, or swap SOL for JUP on Jupiter itself. The 50 JUP minimum stake is a floor, not a target: your share of the pool scales with size and duration. Keep some SOL spare for network fees. Alternatively, you can use the below widget to swap or bridge assets for SOL & JUP. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Stake JUP Through the Governance Portal
steps.body: Go to the Jupiter governance portal , connect your wallet, and stake. Unstaking has a 30-day cooldown, so treat the position as locked for at least a quarter if you plan to farm consecutive rounds.

steps.title: Vote on Active DAO Proposals
steps.body: Passive staking earns nothing. Open the active proposals in the governance portal and vote on each one. Jupiter rewards participation rather than accuracy, so voting on the losing side still counts toward your allocation.

steps.title: Claim Your Q2 2026 ASR Rewards
steps.body: The Q2 pool holds 50 million JUP and the window runs until October 8, 2026. Claims go through Jupiter Mobile or the browser extension, not the web app: Install Jupiter Mobile on iOS or Android, or add the browser extension Import the wallet that held your stake between April and June Open the ASR rewards page inside the app Review the allocation and approve the claim transaction

steps.title: Trade With Ultra and Prediction Markets
steps.body: Fee-paying activity has driven every Jupiter reward campaign so far, and the protocol keeps running new ones. Three things worth doing on the Jupiter website : Route swaps through Ultra Mode, which recent trader campaigns have been keyed to Try the Kalshi-powered prediction markets , where each position settles at $1 if correct and $0 if not Open the Referral tab, create a link, and set a fee rate up to 1% on tokens you choose

steps.title: Open a Gacha Pack
steps.body: Visit the Gacha packs page and connect a Solana wallet. Fund the wallet with USDC. You can purchase USDC directly from Binance . Choose a tier: Silver ($25), Gold ($50), Water ($100), Diamond ($250), Grail ($1,000) or God ($2,500) for Pokémon, or Straw Hat ($50) and Emperor ($250) for One Piece. Open the pack, then keep the card, list it on the Gacha marketplace , or use instant buyback to sell it for USDC within three days. Pack spend builds battlepass progress toward free packs and sets your rank on the season leaderboard , where the top collectors split the prize pool once the season ends. Turbo mode auto-sells common pulls for USDC.

items.description: The Jupiter airdrop is confirmed and has run in phases since January 2024. Jupuary 2026 was the third and final annual distribution, and its claim window has now closed. Unclaimed allocations went back to the DAO treasury. What continues is Active Staking Rewards (ASR), a quarterly pool paid to JUP stakers who vote on DAO proposals, and the Q2 2026 round is open for claims now.

items.name: Grvt
items.tagline: The airdrop is confirmed, retroactive, and live. A fixed pool of 280 million $GRVT goes to traders who earned points dur

steps.title: Open the GRVT reward portal
steps.body: Sign in at the GRVT website and go to the reward portal with the exact account you traded with during Season 1 or Season 2. Allocations are tied to that account, so use the same email and wallet.

steps.title: Check your allocation
steps.body: The checker is live. Your $GRVT figure reflects your combined points from both seasons, adjusted for any Multiplier Plan you locked in before the July 17 cutoff.

steps.title: Confirm how your first tranche arrives
steps.body: If you registered before July 17 and selected a destination, your first tranche is sent automatically. Tokens routed to your GRVT account land immediately at the TGE; external BSC or Ethereum wallets can take up to 30 minutes because of network congestion.

steps.title: Claim manually if you registered after July 17
steps.body: Later registrants claim through the reward portal instead. Locate your unlocked batch, click Claim, and the $GRVT is credited to your GRVT account once confirmed. If several batches are unlocked, claim each one individually.

steps.title: Claim each remaining tranche over the next 12 months
steps.body: Standard plan tokens keep unlocking in batches across the year. Multiplier Plan distributions begin at Month 4 (2x) or Month 8 (4x). Each unlocked batch has a 30 day claim window with no exceptions afterward, so set a reminder ahead of every unlock date.

items.description: The airdrop is confirmed, retroactive, and live. A fixed pool of 280 million $GRVT goes to traders who earned points during Genesis Season 1 (100 million tokens) and Season 2 (180 million tokens). Both seasons have closed and point totals are final. Registration closed on July 27, 2026 (00:00 UTC): users who registered and accepted the terms in time can now check and claim their allocation, while unregistered allocations are forfeited with no exceptions. What remains is checking your amount and claiming your tranches on schedule.

items.name: Ethena
items.tagline: Ethena runs a seasonal rewards program where users earn points called “Sats” for holding and deploying USDe, staking ENA

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Ethena App
steps.body: Go to the Ethena app and click “Connect Wallet.” Ethena supports MetaMask, WalletConnect, and other major Ethereum wallets. Make sure you are on Ethereum mainnet, since staking happens on the production network.

steps.title: Acquire Stablecoins or ENA
steps.body: You need stablecoins to mint USDe, and optionally ENA to stake for the highest base multiplier. If you do not already hold these, buy them from Binance and withdraw to your wallet: USDT, USDC, DAI, or FRAX to mint USDe ENA to stake and lock as sENA Keep some ETH on hand for gas.

steps.title: Mint USDe
steps.body: Open the “Buy” section in the Ethena app and swap your stablecoins for USDe. Holding USDe starts accruing Sats automatically.

steps.title: Stake USDe for sUSDe
steps.body: Navigate to the “Stake” section and convert USDe into sUSDe. This earns protocol yield from funding rates on top of your Sats.

steps.title: Stake and Lock ENA for sENA
steps.body: Go to the staking section, stake your ENA to receive sENA, then lock it. Locking sENA carries one of the strongest Sats multipliers in the program (reported around 40x), and longer lock durations increase the boost. Locked sENA also accrues points for partner ecosystems including Ethereal , Derive, and Echelon.

steps.title: Deploy Into Partner Protocols
steps.body: Route your USDe and sUSDe through integrated DeFi platforms to stack additional multipliers. Options include: Pendle USDe markets, which have offered the highest reported boosts (up to 60x) USDe/sUSDe liquidity pools for roughly 30x Yield vaults such as Strata and Ethereal, also around 30x Check current multipliers in the app before committing, since rates shift between partners and seasons.

steps.title: Farm Cross-Chain on Solana and Avalanche
steps.body: USDe works beyond Ethereum, and activity on other chains qualifies for points and ecosystem rewards. Bridge USDe using a service like the bridge below, then connect a Solana or Avalanche wallet on the Sats page to keep earning across networks. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Track Your Sats and Claim at Season End
steps.body: Monitor your accumulated Sats on the Ethena dashboard during the season. When Season 6 closes, return to the official claim portal, connect the same wallet, and claim your ENA. Keep ETH available for the claim transaction.

items.description: Ethena runs a seasonal rewards program where users earn points called “Sats” for holding and deploying USDe, staking ENA, and using partner protocols. Each season ends with a proportional ENA distribution based on the Sats you accumulated. Five seasons have already paid out, and Season 6 is currently live.

items.name: Grass

steps.title: Check Your Eligibility
steps.body: Open the Grass Dashboard Go to the Allocation tab Review your estimated rewards in the Rewards Checker

steps.title: Claim Your Rewards
steps.body: After 1:00 PM EST on July 22, open the Grass Dashboard Confirm your claim Rewards are deposited into your in-app, self-custodial wallet, which can be exported at any time A small network fee is deducted from claimed rewards to cover on-chain delivery; Grass does not keep this fee. Full eligibility terms are outlined in the Grass Rewards Program Terms and Conditions . Only check and claim through the official dashboard: Grass will never DM first or ask for a seed phrase or private keys.
